protocol: Fixed REFUGE2 specialist fit=120; nested stratified feedback subsets 30 (seeds 31,32,33; 31 primary) and full 80. Same feature-credit, HCL memory, SkillOpt action repertoire for every size. Paired true mask-derived vCDR loss of keep and fusion, at most two specialists. Cross-fit feature credit using held-out folds: full feature set recommends beneficial review, same group alone recommends review, complement does not. Frozen 5 folds, tree depth 2, min_leaf=max(4,ceil(n_train*.15)), benefit threshold .002. Compare stop, cup confidence, geometry, both; frozen VLM selects bounded executable edit from fit feedback incl OOF gains and harms; no panel data for selection. Report raw policies vs always stop and earlier 80-image rule on gate40, prior160 diagnostic and prior400 measurement; 80 vs primary30 paired MAE CI and previously correct retention; gate requires improved MAE and no BACC loss vs first pass. Reused panels exploratory. No reranking after gate.
